grammar.title: 看上去/看起来
grammar.titleEn: Set Phrases 看上去/看起来
grammar.scene: 描述某人或某物的外观、感觉或状态。
grammar.structure: 人/物 + 看上去/看起来 + 描述
grammar.explanation: 固定短语“看上去”和“看起来”可以用来描述某人或某物给人的感觉。

examples.pinyin: Tāmen kàn shangqu yǒudiǎnr xiàng.
examples.english: They look a bit alike.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi kàn qǐlai hěn zhòng.
examples.english: This suitcase looks heavy.

examples.hanzi: 那个新来的老师看上去很年轻。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xīn lái de lǎoshī kàn shangqu hěn niánqīng.
examples.english: That new teacher looks young.

grammar.title: 疑问代词的非疑问用法（1）
grammar.scene: 表达不知道或不需要明确指出人、事物、地点或时间。
grammar.structure: 哪儿/什么/谁/哪 + 陈述句
grammar.explanation: 疑问代词在陈述句中可以表示不确定信息。

examples.hanzi: 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr kàndào guo zhège xiāngzi.
examples.english: I feel like I saw this suitcase somewhere.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ chī diǎnr shénme zài zǒu ba.
examples.english: Eat something before you go.

examples.hanzi: 我们哪天一起去踢足球吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen nǎ tiān yìqǐ qù tī zúqiú ba.
examples.english: Let's go play soccer together sometime.

grammar.title: 多项定语
grammar.scene: 用多个信息描述同一个人或物。
grammar.structure: 时间/处所 + 动作/状态 + 特点 + 的 + 名词
grammar.explanation: 名词前可以有多个定语，一般按时间/处所、动作/状态、特点的顺序排列。

examples.hanzi: 李文是那个穿着黑衣服的短头发的年轻人吗？
examples.pinyin: Lǐ Wén shì nàge chuānzhe hēi yīfu de duǎn tóufa de niánqīngrén ma?
examples.english: Is Li Wen that young person with short hair wearing black clothes?

examples.hanzi: 昨天和家月一起看电影的两个人是我的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān hé Jiāyuè yìqǐ kàn diànyǐng de liǎng ge rén shì wǒ de péngyou.
examples.english: The two people who watched a movie with Jiayue yesterday are my friends.

examples.hanzi: 我那件新买的白色的衣服在哪儿？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nà jiàn xīn mǎi de báisè de yīfu zài nǎr?
examples.english: Where is that new white piece of clothing I bought?

texts.title: 课文一：我们去机场接你们
texts.setting: 在家里，刘明和王一雪在沙发上聊天儿。

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 这是杨同乐吗？他怎么跟白家月在一起？
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì Yáng Tónglè ma? Tā zěnme gēn Bái Jiāyuè zài yìqǐ?
lines.english: Is this Yang Tongle? Why is he with Bai Jiayue?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 他不是杨同乐，他叫李文，是白家月的好朋友。
lines.pinyin: Tā bú shì Yáng Tónglè, tā jiào Lǐ Wén, shì Bái Jiāyuè de hǎo péngyou.
lines.english: He is not Yang Tongle. His name is Li Wen, and he's Bai Jiayue's good friend.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 我还以为是同乐呢，他们看上去有点儿像。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì Tónglè ne, tāmen kàn shangqu yǒudiǎnr xiàng.
lines.english: I thought it was Tongle; they look a bit alike.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 是长得有点儿像，但是他比同乐高，身高有一米八。

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 看起来也比同乐瘦一点儿。

lines.hanzi: 下个星期家月和李文要来北京，我去机场接他们。

lines.english: It's a black suitcase with my name and phone number written on it.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 我好像在哪儿看到过这个箱子，是不是有人拿错了？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr kàndào guo zhège xiāngzi, shì bu shì yǒurén ná cuò le?
lines.english: I feel like I saw this suitcase somewhere; did someone take the wrong one?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我们快找谁问一下吧，箱子里有不少重要的东西。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen kuài zhǎo shéi wèn yíxià ba, xiāngzi li yǒu bù shǎo zhòngyào de dōngxi.
lines.english: Let's quickly find someone to ask. There are a lot of important things in the suitcase.

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 别着急，我们拿着护照和机票，去服务台问问吧。
lines.pinyin: Bié zháojí, wǒmen názhe hùzhào hé jīpiào, qù fúwùtái wènwen ba.
lines.english: Don't worry. Let's take our passports and tickets to the service desk to ask.

texts.title: 课文三：在机场找人
texts.setting: 在机场大厅，刘明和王一雪接机。

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 飞机早就到了，你看见白家月他们了吗？
lines.pinyin: Fēijī zǎojiù dào le, nǐ kànjiàn Bái Jiāyuè tāmen le ma?
lines.english: The plane arrived a while ago. Did you see Bai Jiayue and the others?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 没有，他们应该快出来了。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, tāmen yīnggāi kuài chūlai le.
lines.english: No, they should be coming out soon.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 我们站到中间去吧，这样他们好找一些。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhàn dào zhōngjiān qù ba, zhèyàng tāmen hǎo zhǎo yìxiē.
lines.english: Let's stand in the middle so it's easier for them to find us.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 你看那个高个子的人是李文吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn nàge gāogèzi de rén shì Lǐ Wén ma?
lines.english: Look, is that tall person Li Wen?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.hanzi: 你说的是哪个？那个穿着黑衣服的短头发的年轻人？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de shì nǎge? Nàge chuānzhe hēi yīfu de duǎn tóufa de niánqīngrén?
lines.english: Which one are you talking about? That young person with short hair wearing black clothes?

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 对，那个人就是李文！你看，家月在他后面呢。
lines.pinyin: Duì, nàge rén jiù shì Lǐ Wén! Nǐ kàn, Jiāyuè zài tā hòumiàn ne.
lines.english: Yes, that person is Li Wen! Look, Jiayue is behind him.

texts.title: 课文四：到北京的第一天
texts.setting: 在宾馆房间，李文在写日记。

passage.hanzi: 昨天我到北京了。虽然路上花了十几个小时，但是跟家月坐在一起，我觉得时间过得很快。到机场的时候，家月发现行李箱不见了，我带她去服务台，帮助她找到了行李箱。走出机场的时候，已经八点多了，我们一出来就看见了王老师的姐姐，她看起来比照片上年轻。晚上，一雪姐带我们去吃了一家很好吃的中餐。
passage.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ dào Běijīng le. Suīrán lùshang huāle shí jǐ gè xiǎoshí, dànshì gēn Jiāyuè zuò zài yìqǐ, wǒ juéde shíjiān guò de hěn kuài. Dào jīchǎng de shíhou, Jiāyuè fāxiàn xínglixiāng bú jiàn le, wǒ dài tā qù fúwùtái, bāngzhù tā zhǎodào le xínglixiāng. Zǒu chū jīchǎng de shíhou, yǐjīng bā diǎn duō le, wǒmen yì chūlai jiù kànjiàn le Wáng lǎoshī de jiějie, tā kàn qǐlai bǐ zhàopiàn shang niánqīng. Wǎnshang, Yīxuě jiě dài wǒmen qù chīle yì jiā hěn hǎochī de Zhōngcān.
passage.english: Yesterday I arrived in Beijing. Although the trip took more than ten hours, I felt time passed quickly because I sat with Jiayue. When we arrived at the airport, Jiayue found that her suitcase was missing. I took her to the service desk and helped her find it. When we walked out of the airport, it was already after eight. As soon as we came out, we saw Ms. Wang's older sister. She looked younger than in the photo. In the evening, Sister Yixue took us to a very tasty Chinese meal.

v_hsk3_l01_01.teachingFocus: Use it when the speaker first thought something was true, but later found out it was not.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐwéi shì Tónglè ne.
examples.english: I thought it was Tongle.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ jīntiān bù lái.
examples.english: I thought you were not coming today.

examples.hanzi: 他看起来很像我朋友，我以为是他。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai hěn xiàng wǒ péngyou, wǒ yǐwéi shì tā.
examples.english: He looked a lot like my friend, so I thought it was him.

v_hsk3_l01_01.teacherTip: Use a similar-looking photo pair: first let students guess, then reveal the real identity and model 我还以为是...

v_hsk3_l01_02.teachingFocus: Use it to describe similarity between two people or things.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎnr xiàng.
examples.english: They look a bit alike.

examples.hanzi: 这个人长得像我的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén zhǎng de xiàng wǒ de péngyou.
examples.english: This person looks like my friend.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn bú xiàng tā.
examples.english: This photo does not look like him.

v_hsk3_l01_02.teacherTip: Contrast 像 with 好像 later: 像 is about resemblance; 好像 is about uncertainty.

v_hsk3_l01_03.teachingFocus: In this lesson, focus on 长得... for describing a person's appearance.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen zhǎng de yǒudiǎnr xiàng.
examples.english: They look a little alike.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn gāo.
examples.english: He is tall.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de bú tài xiàng zhàopiàn.
examples.english: She does not look much like the photo.

v_hsk3_l01_03.teacherTip: Make the pronunciation explicit: this is zhǎng, not cháng. Keep the focus on 长得 + adjective/像.

v_hsk3_l01_04.teachingFocus: Use it to ask or state a person's height.

examples.pinyin: Tā de shēngāo shì yì mǐ bā.
examples.english: His height is 1.8 meters.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā de shēngāo ma?
examples.english: Do you know his height?

examples.hanzi: 这个人的身高比我高一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén de shēngāo bǐ wǒ gāo yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: This person is a little taller than me.

v_hsk3_l01_04.teacherTip: Pair this with photos or role cards. Let students guess first, then give the actual height.

v_hsk3_l01_05.teachingFocus: Use it as a unit for height in this lesson.

examples.pinyin: Tā shēngāo yì mǐ bā.
examples.english: He is 1.8 meters tall.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngāo yì mǐ liù wǔ.
examples.english: I am 1.65 meters tall.

examples.pinyin: Nàge rén chàbuduō liǎng mǐ gāo.
examples.english: That person is almost two meters tall.

v_hsk3_l01_05.teacherTip: Explain that 一米八 means 1.8 meters when talking about height. Students do not need decimal notation here.

v_hsk3_l01_06.teachingFocus: Use it carefully to describe a photo or fictional character's appearance.

examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎnr shòu.
examples.english: He looks a little thin.

examples.pinyin: Lǐ Wén bǐ Tónglè shòu yìdiǎnr.
examples.english: Li Wen is a little thinner than Tongle.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn li, tā bú tài shòu.
examples.english: In this photo, he is not very thin.

v_hsk3_l01_06.teacherTip: Avoid asking students to judge classmates' bodies. Use photos, characters, or fictional profiles.

v_hsk3_l01_07.teachingFocus: Use it when someone goes to a place to meet another person and bring them along.

collocations.english: go to the airport to pick someone up

examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù jīchǎng jiē péngyou.
examples.english: I go to the airport to pick up a friend.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǒ lái jiē nǐ.
examples.english: Tomorrow I will come pick you up.

examples.hanzi: 下课以后，妈妈接我回家。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, māma jiē wǒ huí jiā.
examples.english: After class, Mom picks me up and takes me home.

v_hsk3_l01_07.teacherTip: Do not gloss 接 as only meet. It often includes going to a place, waiting, and taking the person away.

v_hsk3_l01_08.teachingFocus: Use it for bags or suitcases people take when they travel.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xíngli bú jiàn le.
examples.english: My luggage is missing.

examples.pinyin: Lǐ Wén zài jīchǎng ná xíngli.
examples.english: Li Wen gets his luggage at the airport.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù fúwùtái zhǎo xíngli.
examples.english: We go to the service desk to look for the luggage.

v_hsk3_l01_08.teacherTip: Use the airport picture and ask: 行李在哪儿？谁的行李不见了？

v_hsk3_l01_09.teachingFocus: Use 丢 when a person loses something; it often starts a problem-solving scene.

examples.pinyin: Tā de xiāngzi diū le.
examples.english: His suitcase is lost.

examples.pinyin: Bié zháojí, wǒmen yìqǐ zhǎo.
examples.english: Do not worry. We will look for it together.

examples.pinyin: Hùzhào bù néng diū.
examples.english: You must not lose your passport.

v_hsk3_l01_09.teacherTip: Contrast 丢了 and 不见了: 丢了 focuses on losing; 不见了 focuses on not being visible or missing.

v_hsk3_l01_10.teachingFocus: In this lesson, 箱子 means a suitcase in an airport scene.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi shì Lǐ Wén de ma?
examples.english: Is this suitcase Li Wen's?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiāngzi shì hēisè de.
examples.english: My suitcase is black.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng kàn yíxià xiāngzi hàomǎ.
examples.english: Please check the suitcase number.

v_hsk3_l01_10.teacherTip: Ask students to add one clue at a time: 颜色, 大小, 号码.

v_hsk3_l01_11.teachingFocus: Use it for phone numbers, ticket numbers, luggage numbers, or service numbers.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
examples.english: What is your phone number?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ xíngli hàomǎ.
examples.english: Please tell me the luggage number.

examples.pinyin: Zhège hàomǎ hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: This number is important.

v_hsk3_l01_11.teacherTip: Connect 号码 with concrete classroom objects: phone number, room number, luggage number.

v_hsk3_l01_12.teachingFocus: Use it when the speaker is not completely sure.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoxiàng zài nǎr jiàn guo tā.
examples.english: I seem to have seen him somewhere.

examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi hǎoxiàng shì wǒ de.
examples.english: This suitcase seems to be mine.

examples.pinyin: Tā hǎoxiàng yǒudiǎnr zháojí.
examples.english: He seems a little worried.

v_hsk3_l01_12.teacherTip: Use guessing scenes. Students should feel 好像 means uncertain, not confirmed.

v_hsk3_l01_13.teachingFocus: Use it to mark key information, objects, or actions.

examples.pinyin: Hùzhào hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: The passport is important.

examples.pinyin: Diànhuà hàomǎ shì zhòngyào xìnxī.
examples.english: A phone number is important information.

examples.hanzi: 在机场，行李号码很重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīchǎng, xíngli hàomǎ hěn zhòngyào.
examples.english: At the airport, the luggage number is important.

v_hsk3_l01_13.teacherTip: Ask students to sort airport information: 什么最重要？为什么？

v_hsk3_l01_14.teachingFocus: Use it for an urgent feeling when something goes wrong.

examples.pinyin: Xíngli bú jiàn le, tā hěn zháojí.
examples.english: His luggage is missing, so he is very worried.

examples.pinyin: Bié zháojí, wǒ lái bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: Do not worry. I will help you.

examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎnr zháojí.
examples.english: She looks a little worried.

v_hsk3_l01_14.teacherTip: Pair this with problem scenes: lost luggage, cannot find a person, late pickup.

v_hsk3_l01_15.teachingFocus: Use it as a key object in travel and airport situations.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng ná chū nǐ de hùzhào.
examples.english: Please take out your passport.

examples.pinyin: Tā de hùzhào zài xiāngzi li.
examples.english: His passport is in the suitcase.

examples.pinyin: Hùzhào hàomǎ bù néng cuò.
examples.english: The passport number must not be wrong.

v_hsk3_l01_15.teacherTip: Use simple travel-object cards. Avoid long administrative explanations.

v_hsk3_l01_16.teachingFocus: Use it as the place people go to ask for help.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù fúwùtái wèn yi wèn.
examples.english: Let's go to the service desk and ask.

examples.hanzi: 服务台的人帮助了我们。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùtái de rén bāngzhù le wǒmen.
examples.english: The person at the service desk helped us.

examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fúwùtái zài nǎr?
examples.english: Where is the airport service desk?

v_hsk3_l01_16.teacherTip: This word is best taught through a mini role-play: problem -> service desk -> help.

v_hsk3_l01_17.teachingFocus: Use it to make a reasonable guess or give advice.

examples.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi kuài chūlái le.
examples.english: He should come out soon.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi qù fúwùtái wènwen.
examples.english: You should go ask the service desk.

examples.pinyin: Xiāngzi yīnggāi zài jīchǎng.
examples.english: The suitcase should be at the airport.

v_hsk3_l01_17.teacherTip: Keep 应该 as advice or likely guess. Do not expand into obligation-heavy grammar yet.

v_hsk3_l01_18.teachingFocus: Use it to describe where a person is standing.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài zhōngjiān.
examples.english: He is standing in the middle.

examples.pinyin: Bái Jiāyuè zhàn zài chūkǒu děng tā.
examples.english: Bai Jiayue stands at the exit and waits for him.

examples.hanzi: 那个年轻人站在服务台旁边。
examples.pinyin: Nàge niánqīng rén zhàn zài fúwùtái pángbiān.
examples.english: That young person is standing beside the service desk.

v_hsk3_l01_18.teacherTip: Use the classroom or airport picture to ask: 谁站在哪儿？

v_hsk3_l01_19.teachingFocus: Use it to describe a location between two sides or people.

examples.pinyin: Zhōngjiān de rén shì Lǐ Wén.
examples.english: The person in the middle is Li Wen.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài chūkǒu zhōngjiān.
examples.english: He is standing in the middle of the exit area.

examples.pinyin: Fúwùtái zài dàtīng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: The service desk is in the middle of the hall.

v_hsk3_l01_19.teacherTip: Use visual pointing. 中间 is easier with a picture than with a definition.

v_hsk3_l01_20.teachingFocus: In this lesson, use it for hair length.

examples.pinyin: Tā shì duǎn tóufa.
examples.english: He has short hair.

examples.hanzi: 照片里的人头发比较短。
examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn li de rén tóufa bǐjiào duǎn.
examples.english: The person in the photo has relatively short hair.

examples.pinyin: Tā de tóufa bù duǎn.
examples.english: Her hair is not short.

v_hsk3_l01_20.teacherTip: Teach 短 together with 头发. Avoid opening unrelated meanings too early.

v_hsk3_l01_21.teachingFocus: Use it for describing a person's appearance.

examples.pinyin: Lǐ Wén shì duǎn tóufa.
examples.english: Li Wen has short hair.

examples.pinyin: Tā de tóufa hěn cháng.
examples.english: Her hair is long.

examples.hanzi: 这个人的头发是黑色的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège rén de tóufa shì hēisè de.
examples.english: This person's hair is black.

v_hsk3_l01_21.teacherTip: Use person photos and build from word to phrase to sentence: 头发 -> 短头发 -> 他是短头发.

v_hsk3_l01_22.teachingFocus: Use it to describe age impression from appearance.

examples.pinyin: Wáng Yīxuě kàn qǐlai hěn niánqīng.
examples.english: Wang Yixue looks very young.

examples.pinyin: Nàge niánqīng rén shì Lǐ Wén.
examples.english: That young person is Li Wen.

examples.pinyin: Tā bǐ zhàopiàn shang niánqīng.
examples.english: She is younger than in the photo.

v_hsk3_l01_22.teacherTip: Use 看起来年轻 to keep the description as visual impression, not personal judgment.

v_hsk3_l01_23.teachingFocus: Use it when someone notices new information after looking or checking.

examples.hanzi: 白家月发现箱子不见了。
examples.pinyin: Bái Jiāyuè fāxiàn xiāngzi bú jiàn le.
examples.english: Bai Jiayue found that the suitcase was missing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn tā bú shì Yáng Tónglè.
examples.english: I found out that he was not Yang Tongle.

examples.hanzi: 我们发现服务台在中间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fāxiàn fúwùtái zài zhōngjiān.
examples.english: We found that the service desk was in the middle.

v_hsk3_l01_23.teacherTip: Put 发现 after an action: 看了照片 -> 发现; 到了机场 -> 发现.

v_hsk3_l01_24.teachingFocus: Use 不见了 when something or someone cannot be found.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiāngzi bú jiàn le.
examples.english: My suitcase is missing.

examples.pinyin: Hùzhào bú jiàn le, tā hěn zháojí.
examples.english: His passport is missing, so he is very worried.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fāxiàn xíngli bú jiàn le.
examples.english: We found that the luggage was missing.

v_hsk3_l01_24.teacherTip: Teach 不见了 as a useful problem statement students can use immediately.

v_hsk3_l01_25.teachingFocus: Use it when a person brings someone or something to another place.

examples.pinyin: Wáng Yīxuě dài wǒmen qù chīfàn.
examples.english: Wang Yixue takes us to eat.

examples.pinyin: Lái jīchǎng yào dài hùzhào.
examples.english: You need to bring your passport when coming to the airport.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ dài péngyou qù fúwùtái.
examples.english: I take my friend to the service desk.

v_hsk3_l01_25.teacherTip: Contrast 带 and 接 through direction: 接 someone from a place; 带 someone to a place.

v_hsk3_l01_26.teachingFocus: Use it for helping someone solve a problem.

examples.hanzi: 刘明帮助白家月找行李。
examples.pinyin: Liú Míng bāngzhù Bái Jiāyuè zhǎo xíngli.
examples.english: Liu Ming helps Bai Jiayue find the luggage.

examples.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: Thank you for your help.

examples.hanzi: 服务台的人可以帮助你。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùtái de rén kěyǐ bāngzhù nǐ.
examples.english: The person at the service desk can help you.

v_hsk3_l01_26.teacherTip: Make this a closing move in role-play: problem -> ask -> help -> thank.

v_hsk3_l01_27.teachingFocus: Use it as evidence for identifying or describing a person.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yì zhāng zhàopiàn.
examples.english: I only have one photo.

examples.hanzi: 照片里的人看起来很年轻。
examples.pinyin: Zhàopiàn li de rén kàn qǐlai hěn niánqīng.
examples.english: The person in the photo looks very young.

examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn bú xiàng tā.
examples.english: This photo does not look like him.

v_hsk3_l01_27.teacherTip: Use 照片 to connect preview mission, text misunderstanding, and follow-up speaking.

previewMissions.title: 去机场接朋友
previewMissions.titleEn: Pick Up a Friend at the Airport
previewMissions.spoilerPolicy: 只预热接机和外貌描述主题，不直接复现课文一人物关系、误会和结局。
previewMissions.roleDescriptionEn: You are a student volunteer at the airport. Your job is to meet a new friend you have never seen before. You only have one photo and a few clues.
previewMissions.storyIntro: 你今天有一个任务：去机场接一位新朋友。你以前没有见过他，只收到了一张照片和几条简单信息。机场里人很多，你需要先知道他长什么样，然后想一想：到了机场以后怎么找到他？见到他以后怎么打招呼？
previewMissions.storyIntroEn: Today you have a mission: pick up a new friend at the airport. You have never met him before. You only have one photo and a few simple clues. Look carefully, then decide how to find him and what to say when you meet.

stages.title: 看照片，认识新朋友
stages.taskGoal: 通过照片或插画观察人物外貌。
stages.taskGoalEn: Observe your new friend's appearance from the photo.
stages.screenPromptEn: Look at the friend photo. What does he look like?

items.question: 他看起来高还是矮？
items.questionEn: Choose the best Chinese word: tall or short?

items.question: 他看起来胖还是瘦？
items.questionEn: Choose the best Chinese word: heavy or thin?

items.question: 他的头发长还是短？
items.questionEn: Choose the best Chinese word for his hair.

stages.feedback: 你已经看清楚朋友的外貌了。

undercover.title: 像 vs 好像
undercover.rule: Four students describe their card in Chinese. They cannot say the word directly.
undercover.teacherHint: 像 focuses on resemblance; 好像 often shows uncertainty.

undercover.title: 接 vs 见
undercover.rule: Students explain the action in Chinese without saying the target word.
undercover.teacherHint: 接 includes meeting someone and taking them with you; 见 only means seeing or meeting.

undercover.title: 丢 vs 不见了
undercover.rule: Students describe a missing item. The class votes for the undercover player.
undercover.teacherHint: 不见了 describes the current state; 丢 can emphasize losing something.

A.prompt_cn: 复习整理：写下本次课 3 个最重要的词语或短语，并各写一个中文解释。
A.prompt_en: Review notes: write 3 key words or phrases from this session and explain each one in simple Chinese.
A.bridgeToNext: 第二次课开场用学生解释回收“用中文解释中文”的能力。

A.prompt_cn: 书面输出：请用“看起来、像、有点儿”写 2-3 句话描述一个人。
A.prompt_en: Written output: write 2-3 Chinese sentences to describe one person with 看起来, 像, or 有点儿.
A.bridgeToNext: 第二次课开场可匿名展示并升级学生描述。

A.prompt_cn: 口语输出：看一张人物照片，用中文说 20-30 秒：他/她看起来怎么样？你怎么找到他/她？
A.prompt_en: Oral output: look at a person photo and record 20-30 seconds in Chinese: What does the person look like? How will you find him or her?
A.bridgeToNext: 第二次课用 2-3 个录音做开场回收，转入机场找人与服务台求助。

A.prompt_cn: 下次课准备：写下 2 个机场可能遇到的问题，并各准备一句中文求助句。
A.prompt_en: Next-session prep: write 2 possible problems at the airport and prepare one Chinese help-seeking sentence for each.
A.bridgeToNext: 第二次课进入行李问题和服务台求助时使用。

B.prompt_cn: 复习整理：写下本次课 3 个最重要的词语或短语，并各写一个中文解释。
B.prompt_en: Review notes: write 3 key words or phrases from this session and explain each one in simple Chinese.
B.bridgeToNext: 第三次课开场回收行李问题、服务台求助和找人表达。

B.prompt_cn: 书面输出：你的行李不见了。请写 3 句话说明问题并向服务台求助。
B.prompt_en: Written output: your luggage is missing. Write 3 Chinese sentences to explain the problem and ask the service desk for help.
B.bridgeToNext: 第三次课先回收问题说明，再进入事件顺序和复述。

B.prompt_cn: 口语输出：两人一组准备 4 句机场服务台对话：说明问题、给出信息、得到帮助。
B.prompt_en: Oral output: in pairs, prepare a 4-line Chinese service-desk dialogue: explain the problem, give information, and get help.
B.bridgeToNext: 第三次课可抽一组做 1 分钟对话展示，作为复述前的语言回顾。

B.prompt_cn: 下次课准备：用“先、然后、最后”写 3 个关键词，准备复述李文到北京后的经历。
B.prompt_en: Next-session prep: use 先, 然后, and 最后 to write 3 keywords for retelling Li Wen's experience after arriving in Beijing.
B.bridgeToNext: 第三次课进入课文四和整课复述时使用。

C.prompt_cn: 复习整理：写下本次课 3 个最重要的词语或短语，并各写一个中文解释。
C.prompt_en: Review notes: write 3 key words or phrases from this session and explain each one in simple Chinese.
C.bridgeToNext: 作为 L01 总结复习，进入教师批改、数据报告和后续口语展示。

C.prompt_cn: 书面输出：请用 40-60 字复述李文到北京后的经历。

C.bridgeToNext: 作为 L01 总结性产出，进入教师批改和数据报告。

C.prompt_cn: 口语输出：根据本课故事线，准备 1 分钟中文复述：谁来北京？谁去接？发生了什么？

C.bridgeToNext: 作为 L01 口语展示和同伴听后提问的基础。

C.bridgeToNext: 后续放入课后作业模块，用于课上口语展示和同伴听后提问。
